cards.example_en: I forgot my calculator and had to work out the sums by hand.
cards.example_zh: 我忘了带计算器，只好用手把这些题算出来。

cards.example_en: The street carnival filled the square with music and bright lights.
cards.example_zh: 街头狂欢节让广场充满了音乐和明亮的灯光。

cards.example_en: We found empty seats in the last carriage of the train.
cards.example_zh: 我们在火车最后一节车厢找到了空位。

cards.example_en: Push the cart slowly so the eggs do not roll off.
cards.example_zh: 慢慢推这辆手推车，免得鸡蛋滚下去。

cards.example_en: Please recycle the milk carton after you finish your drink.
cards.example_zh: 喝完后请把牛奶纸盒拿去回收。

cards.example_en: The cashier gave me the wrong change at the supermarket.
cards.example_zh: 超市的收银员把零钱找错了。

cards.example_en: The victory celebration lasted until late at night.
cards.example_zh: 胜利庆典一直持续到深夜。

cards.example_en: Adults drank champagne at the wedding while we had juice.
cards.example_zh: 婚礼上大人们喝香槟，我们喝果汁。

cards.example_en: Fans began to chant the team name as the players ran out.
cards.example_zh: 球员出场时，球迷开始反复喊着队名。

cards.example_en: Grandpa cooked fish over charcoal in the backyard last night.
cards.example_zh: 昨晚爷爷在后院用木炭烤鱼。

cards.example_en: The puppy began to chase a ball across the field.
cards.example_zh: 小狗开始追着球跑过球场。

cards.example_en: There was a long queue at the checkout on Saturday afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 星期六下午，收银台前排着长队。

cards.example_en: He ordered a cheeseburger and fries after football practice.
cards.example_zh: 足球训练后，他点了芝士汉堡和薯条。

cards.example_en: Many of my childhood friends still live on the same street.
cards.example_zh: 我的许多童年朋友仍然住在同一条街上。

cards.example_en: Add a little chili if you like the noodles extra spicy.
cards.example_zh: 如果你喜欢面条更辣，就加一点辣椒。

cards.example_en: I dropped one chopstick under the table during lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭时，我把一根筷子掉到了桌子底下。

cards.example_en: We classify leaves by shape during the biology field trip.
cards.example_zh: 生物实地考察时，我们按形状给叶子分类。

cards.example_en: A clown made balloon animals for children at the fair.
cards.example_zh: 小丑在集市上为孩子们做气球小动物。

cards.example_en: Hens cluck loudly when someone walks near their wooden coop.
cards.example_zh: 有人走近木鸡舍时，母鸡会大声咯咯叫。

cards.example_en: Good cooperation helped our group finish the project on time.
cards.example_zh: 良好的合作帮助我们小组按时完成了项目。

cards.example_en: A cockroach ran across the kitchen floor and hid under the fridge.
cards.example_zh: 一只蟑螂跑过厨房地板，躲到了冰箱底下。

cards.example_en: She bought a cold coke after the long bike ride home.
cards.example_zh: 长途骑车回家后，她买了一杯冰可乐。

cards.example_en: Use this comb if your hair gets messy in the wind.
cards.example_zh: 要是风把头发吹乱了，就用这把梳子。

cards.example_en: The combination of rice and grilled fish is my favourite lunch.
cards.example_zh: 米饭配烤鱼的组合是我最喜欢的午餐。

cards.example_en: Bring your compasses tomorrow so we can draw circles in maths.
cards.example_zh: 明天把圆规带来，数学课上我们要画圆。

cards.example_en: I filed a complaint because the locker room had no hot water.
cards.example_zh: 更衣室没有热水，我为此提交了投诉。

cards.example_en: Her coach gave her a compliment after the difficult match.
cards.example_zh: 那场艰难的比赛之后，教练称赞了她。

cards.example_en: The composer visited our school and played his new song.
cards.example_zh: 那位作曲家来到我们学校，演奏了他的新歌。

cards.example_en: The conductor raised his hands and the orchestra began to play.
cards.example_zh: 指挥举起双手，管弦乐队开始演奏。

cards.example_en: She sounded confident when she introduced the guest speaker.
cards.example_zh: 她介绍演讲嘉宾时，声音听起来很自信。

cards.example_en: He studies piano at a conservatory near the city centre.
cards.example_zh: 他在市中心附近的一所音乐学院学钢琴。

cards.example_en: Each consumer who tasted the new juice wrote a score on the card.
cards.example_zh: 每位品尝新果汁的消费者都在卡片上写了分数。

cards.example_en: The youngest contestant sang a folk song and won second prize.
cards.example_zh: 最年轻的参赛者唱了一首民歌，获得了二等奖。

cards.example_en: Our cookery class taught us how to make tomato egg noodles.
cards.example_zh: 我们的烹饪课教我们怎么做番茄鸡蛋面。

cards.example_en: A cormorant dived into the river and came up with a fish.
cards.example_zh: 一只鸬鹚潜入河里，衔着一条鱼浮了上来。

cards.example_en: The school counsellor helped him choose subjects for next year.
cards.example_zh: 学校辅导员帮他选定了明年的科目。

cards.example_en: We ate steamed crab with ginger at the seafood restaurant.
cards.example_zh: 我们在海鲜餐厅吃了姜蒸螃蟹。

cards.example_en: Knotting bracelets is the craft we practise on rainy club days.
cards.example_zh: 编手链是我们在下雨的社团日练习的手艺。

cards.example_en: These apple slices are crisp and sweet after a day in the fridge.
cards.example_zh: 这些苹果片在冰箱里放了一天后又脆又甜。

cards.example_en: A crocodile lay still beside the pool at the wildlife park.
cards.example_zh: 一只鳄鱼一动不动地躺在野生动物园的水池边。

cards.example_en: Grandma finishes the crossword in the newspaper every morning.
cards.example_zh: 奶奶每天早上都做完报纸上的纵横填字游戏。

cards.example_en: The queen wore a gold crown in the history museum display.
cards.example_zh: 历史博物馆的展品中，女王戴着一顶金王冠。

cards.example_en: The film showed the cruelty of war through one family's story.
cards.example_zh: 这部电影通过一个家庭的故事展现了战争的残忍。

cards.example_en: Curiosity led him to open the old box in the attic.
cards.example_zh: 好奇心促使他打开了阁楼里那个旧箱子。

cards.example_en: Her curly hair gets bigger whenever the weather turns humid.
cards.example_zh: 天气变得潮湿时，她的卷发会蓬得更大。

cards.example_en: Cycling along the river path is my favourite weekend exercise.
cards.example_zh: 沿河骑行是我最喜欢的周末运动。

cards.example_en: He started to daydream and missed the bus stop near school.
cards.example_zh: 他开始做白日梦，错过了学校附近的公交站。

cards.example_en: The museum is free in the daytime on the first Sunday.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆在第一个星期日的白天免费开放。

cards.example_en: Write the answer as a decimal instead of a whole number.
cards.example_zh: 把答案写成小数，不要写成整数。

cards.example_en: Red lanterns were the main decoration at the New Year party.
cards.example_zh: 红灯笼是新年聚会上的主要装饰。
